baseline.why: Reuses the TP1.8h authoritative safe baseline settings for kinetic/temperature consumer tracing.
baseline.runtime_pairlist_line: updated every 10 steps, buffer 0.011 nm, rlist 0.911 nm

variant.why: Switches the Coulomb solver from PME to Ewald while keeping the same authoritative short-range baseline and active kinetic consumer path.
variant.runtime_ordinary_ewald_line: Will do ordinary reciprocal space Ewald sum.
variant.runtime_pairlist_line: updated every 10 steps, buffer 0.011 nm, rlist 0.911 nm
